selection_basis: Extinguishing is an uncovered required properties/fire target. FDMA fire-fighting guidance and registered SDS Section 5 fields provide directly verifiable suitability and prohibited-method propositions.

pinpoint_scope: FDMA掲載『見て解る危険物火災消火活動』の泡消火・注水禁忌・消火活動に関する該当見出し
各MHLW SDS/label の Section 5『火災時の措置』にある適切な消火剤・使ってはならない消火剤
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered source/version and one exact Section 5 field or named FDMA subsection. A question may not compare extinguishing instructions across sources.

planned_families: liquid-surface fire and foam application mechanism decisions
agent suitability versus cooling or vapor-suppression purpose distinctions
small versus spreading fire response boundaries only where directly sourced
extinguishing-action priority misconceptions tied to one named material or guidance subsection
